5  Quick questions

  1. Are the two linen dresses one product or two?
    SB-WES-02 (black) at Rs 2,093 and SB-WES-03 (orange) at Rs 2,093. Right now they are two separate products. If it is one dress in two colours, say so and we will merge them into one with a colour choice.
  2. Are these two necklaces different?
    SB-JWL-09 “Heart hanging necklace” at Rs 350 and SB-JWL-10 “Heart hanging necklace, beaded” at Rs 350 read almost the same. If they differ, what should each be called?
  3. What does delivery cost, and how long does it take?
    The site says “all over India and worldwide” with no charge and no timeline, because none was given. Even “3–5 days within Karnataka” helps a customer decide.
  4. Which pieces are imported and which are Indian?
    Your brand line is “Imported & Indian” but no piece says which, so the cards show the category instead. If it is easier, just tell us which categories are imported.
  5. One real customer review.
    One honest line from a happy customer, with her first name and town. There is a place for it on the site that stays hidden until you give us a real one — we will not write it for you.
  6. Press-on nails and bags.
    Both are listed as categories but have no products, so they show “Coming soon”. Send photos and prices and they go live; tell us to drop them and they come off.
  7. One photograph of a co-ord set being worn.
    The co-ord tile is the weakest picture on the site — it is a flat product render while every other category shows a real photograph. One good photo of SB-COR-01 or SB-COR-02 fixes it.
